notice: The English version is the authoritative one.
privacyLead: MathLift stores a generated space name, class code, lesson progress, and a short history of diagnosis results (misconception type, planet, and timestamp, up to 40). Drawings stay on the device. The same deletion rules remove that history. Optional Explore signals (activity id, ways-found count, timestamp) may stay on the device with other progress and follow the same deletion rules.
cookieLead: MathLift does not use advertising or analytics cookies. A language choice and a sign-in session stay on this device.
supportLead: For help, use the support email on this page. Deleting a student or a class also deletes that diagnosis history.
individualBody: When a child chooses Learn on my own, MathLift stores only a generated space name, an optional 4-digit PIN, lesson progress, and local preferences on this device (browser localStorage, and on iOS a Keychain mirror of that progress). Nothing from individual mode is sent to our servers or written to Firestore unless the learner later joins a class with a class code (not required). Drawings stay on the device. Use Settings → Delete my progress to wipe individual progress on this device. Optional Explore signals (activity id, ways found, timestamp) also stay on this device and are wiped with Delete my progress.
exploreSignalsHow: Recorded when a child saves or finishes an Explore activity
exploreSignalsWhy: Coarse record of which Explore activity was used, how many ways were found, and when. No drawings or free text. Deleted with the same Settings controls as other progress.
